rules.text: never schedule Sunday, Monday, or Saturday.
Fill the **nearest open days first**, then compact gaps; never double-book a tech (leave ~30 min buffer between jobs).
if a meld's title or chat asks for a specific day/time/date, honor it and don't move it.
Business hours ~8:00–17:30 Pacific. Times are ISO with Pacific offset, e.g. `2026-06-25T09:00:00-07:00`.
Jonas + Armani are the only Tacoma techs; reassign anyone else's Tacoma meld to Jonas.

all repairs go to **Justin** (Wade Hippen no longer works here); exclude turns/environmental/pest; only reclaim melds from turn techs (Scott/Ron/Magoon) or unassigned — leave David/Alex/Florencia/Dulce alone.
mirror the current week's recurring lawn-service melds to the same slots +7 days.
